# Data Report

The Quarterly Business Report for Q4 2025 shows a 15% year-over-year revenue growth to $4.2 billion, driven by strong cloud services and enterprise software performance. Operating margin improved to 28%, up from 24% in Q3. Customer acquisition cost decreased by 12% due to better marketing efficiency. The company expanded into Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, and South America. Active users increased by 22% to 45 million, monthly recurring revenue reached $350 million, and the net promoter score rose from 62 to 71. Employee headcount grew to 8,500 across 12 offices globally, with R&D investment at $840 million, representing 20% of revenue. The outlook for Q1 2026 expects revenue between $4.4 billion and $4.6 billion, focusing on launching an AI-powered analytics platform, expanding the partner ecosystem, and achieving SOC 2 Type II certification for all cloud products.
